# Temple Scroll Column 61 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 61 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**61:1** When you go forth to battle against your enemies, and I, the LORD your God, give them into your hand, and you take captives from among them,

**61:2** and you see among the captives a woman beautiful of form, and you desire her, and you would take her for yourself as a wife,

**61:3** then you shall bring her into the midst of your house, and she shall shave her head and she shall pare her nails.

**61:4** And she shall put away the garment of her captivity from upon her, and she shall dwell in your house and weep for her father and for her mother a full month of days.

**61:5** And after that you may go in unto her and become her husband, and she shall be to you a wife.

**61:6** And it shall be, if you delight not in her, then you shall send her away according to the desire of her soul; but you shall not sell her for silver.

**61:7** You shall not deal tyrannically with her, inasmuch as you have humbled her.

**61:8** If a man has two wives, the one loved and the other hated, and they bear him sons, the loved one and the hated one,

**61:9** and the firstborn son belongs to the hated one, then on the day that he causes his sons to inherit what belongs to him,

**61:10** he shall not be permitted to make the son of the loved one the firstborn before the son of the hated one, who is the firstborn.

**61:11** But the firstborn, the son of the hated one, he shall acknowledge, to give him a double portion of all that is found belonging to him,

**61:12** for he is the beginning of his strength; to him belongs the right of the firstborn.

**61:13** If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son, who does not obey the voice of his father or the voice of his mother,

**61:14** and they discipline him, but he does not listen to them, then his father and his mother shall seize him and bring him out to the elders of his city, to the gate of his place.

**61:15** And they shall say to the elders of his city: This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious; he does not obey our voice; he is a glutton and a drunkard.

**61:16** And all the men of his city shall stone him with stones, and he shall die. And you shall purge the evil from your midst, and all Israel shall hear and fear.

---

*EMET notes: Column 61 closely follows Deut 21:10–21 but with characteristic first-person divine speech. "I, the LORD your God, give them" replaces Deuteronomy's third-person "the LORD your God gives them." The laws of the captive woman, firstborn rights, and rebellious son are rendered in strict literal sequence. "Deal tyrannically" for תתעמר preserves the rare Hebrew verb form. "Double portion" (pi shenayim) maintained as idiomatic construct.*
